verdict.rationale: Phoenix's self-hosting docs state that when self-hosted, data stays entirely within your infrastructure and nothing is sent to Arize, and it 'can be fully air-gapped,' which strongly implies no mandatory telemetry/usage tracking is phoned home in that mode. However, there is no explicit documentation of an opt-out flag/setting or of what telemetry (if any) exists in the hosted/SaaS version to disable. Missing for 10: explicit telemetry/usage-tracking opt-out mechanism or setting, documentation of what data (if any) is collected in non-self-hosted use, independent confirmation of no phone-home behavior.
